text_en: The divisions of the descendants of Aaron were these. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
text_cn: 亚郎的子孙也有他们的班次。亚郎的儿子：纳达布、阿彼胡、厄肋阿匝尔和依塔玛尔。

text_en: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar became the priests.
text_cn: 纳达布和阿彼胡在他们父亲以前死了，又没有儿子，所以厄肋阿匝尔和依塔玛尔作了司祭。

text_en: Along with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, David organized them according to the appointed duties in their service.
text_cn: 达味和厄肋阿匝尔的后裔匝多克，并依塔玛尔的后裔阿希默肋客，将他们的同族兄弟分开班次，按班服役。

text_en: Since more chief men were found among the sons of Eleazar than among the sons of Ithamar, they organized them under sixteen heads of ancestral houses of the sons of Eleazar, and eight of the sons of Ithamar.
text_cn: 以后发现厄肋阿匝尔的子孙中为首领的人，多于依塔玛尔的子孙，遂将他们如此划分：厄肋阿匝尔的后裔中族长十六人，依塔玛尔的后裔中族长八人，

text_en: They organized them by lot, all alike, for there were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God among both the sons of Eleazar and the sons of Ithamar.
text_cn: 以抽签方式将他们分开，彼此同列，因为在厄肋阿匝尔子孙中和依塔玛尔子孙中，都有在圣所作首领和在天主面前作首领的。

text_en: The scribe Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, recorded them in the presence of the king, and the officers, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the heads of ancestral houses of the priests and of the Levites; one ancestral house being chosen for Eleazar and one chosen for Ithamar.
text_cn: 肋未人乃塔乃耳的儿子舍玛雅书记在君王、首领、司祭匝多克、厄彼雅塔尔的儿子阿希默肋客和众司祭及肋未族长前登记：一签为厄肋阿匝尔家族，一签为依塔玛尔家族。

text_en: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
text_cn: 中签的：首为约雅黎布，次为耶达雅，

text_en: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
text_cn: 三为哈陵，四为色敖陵，

text_en: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
text_cn: 五为玛耳基雅，六为米雅明，

text_en: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
text_cn: 七为哈科兹，八为阿彼雅，

text_en: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
text_cn: 九为耶叔亚，十为舍加尼雅，

text_en: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
text_cn: 十一为厄肋雅史布，十二为雅肯，

text_en: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
text_cn: 十三为胡帕，十四为耶舍贝阿布，

text_en: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
text_cn: 十五为彼耳加，十六为依默尔，

text_en: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
text_cn: 十七为赫齐尔，十八为哈丕责兹，

text_en: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
text_cn: 十九为培塔希雅，二十为耶赫次刻耳，

text_en: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
text_cn: 二十一为雅津，二十二为加慕耳，

text_en: the twenty-third to Delaiah, the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
text_cn: 二十三为德拉雅，二十四为玛阿齐雅。

text_en: These had as their appointed duty in their service to enter the house of the Lord according to the procedure established for them by their ancestor Aaron, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.
text_cn: 这就是他们进入上主殿内，按照上主以色列的天主吩咐他们祖先亚郎所制定的规律，供职的班次。

text_en: And of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
text_cn: 肋未的其余后裔中，有阿默兰的子孙叔巴耳；叔巴耳的子孙中，有耶赫狄雅。

text_en: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
text_cn: 至于勒哈彼雅：勒哈彼雅子孙中，为首的是依史雅。

text_en: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
text_cn: 依兹哈尔的子孙中，有舍罗摩特；舍罗摩特子孙中，有雅哈特。

text_en: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
text_cn: 赫贝龙的子孙中，为首的是耶黎雅，次为阿玛黎雅，三为乌齐耳，四为耶卡默罕。

text_en: The sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
text_cn: 乌齐耳的子孙中，有米加，米加的子孙中，有沙米尔。

text_en: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
text_cn: 米加的弟兄：依史雅；依史雅的子孙中，有则加黎雅。

text_en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Jaaziah: Beno.
text_cn: 默辣黎的子孙中，有玛赫里和慕史及雅哈齐雅的儿子巴尼。

text_en: The sons of Merari: of Jaaziah, Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
text_cn: 默辣黎的子孙中，有雅哈齐雅的儿子巴尼、芍罕、匝雇尔和依贝黎。

text_en: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
text_cn: 玛赫里的儿子：厄肋阿匝尔和克士；厄肋阿匝尔没有儿子。

text_en: Of Kish, the sons of Kish: Jerahmeel.
text_cn: 至于克士：克士的儿子是耶辣默耳。

text_en: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their ancestral houses.
text_cn: 慕史的儿子：玛赫里、厄德尔和耶黎摩特。这些人按照他们的家族，都是肋未的后裔。

text_en: These also cast lots corresponding to their kindred, the descendants of Aaron, in the presence of King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of ancestral houses of the priests and of the Levites, the chief as well as the youngest brother.
text_cn: 他们在达味君王与匝多克、阿希默肋客，并司祭及肋未人的族长面前，像他们的弟兄亚郎的子孙，族长与年幼的兄弟，都一样抽了签。
